svg.title: Detailed local PDF production workflow
svg.desc: Handwritten black-and-white diagram showing the detailed local PDF workflow. Dashed QA loop stays outside the bordered cards, and card labels are bold and separated from icons.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Bradley Hand ITC, Virgil, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Bradley Hand ITC, Virgil, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: local files -> render/read -> source -> generate -> QA loop -> registered artifact
